text.en:
1.—(1) These Regulations may be cited as the Medical Registration (Certifying Authority) Regulations 2014 and shall, with the exception of regulation 3(2) and (3), come into operation on 1 December 2014.
(2) Regulation 3(2) shall be deemed to have come into operation on 5 December 2011.
(3) Regulation 3(3) shall be deemed to have come into operation on 4 September 2014.

heading.en: Certifying authority for purposes of section 25(3)(c)

text.en:
3.—(1) The Chair of the National Assessment Committee for Post‑Graduate Year 1 shall be a certifying authority in respect of any person who has been employed in the manner referred to in section 25(1) of the Act.
(2) Clinical Prof Raj Mohan Nambiar shall be a certifying authority, from 5 December 2011 to 30 November 2014 (both dates inclusive), in respect of any person who has been employed in the manner referred to in section 25(1) of the Act and who holds a Doctor of Medicine of the Duke‑NUS Graduate Medical School Singapore.
(3) Clinical Prof Raj Mohan Nambiar shall be a certifying authority, from 4 September 2014 to 30 November 2014 (both dates inclusive), in respect of any person who has been employed in the manner referred to in section 25(1) of the Act and who holds any degree under the First or Second Schedule to the Act, other than a Doctor of Medicine of the Duke‑NUS Graduate Medical School Singapore.
